modules.name: SynTHBloK-QUAD Quad Oscillator Synth
modules.description: Quad-oscillator synth voice with filter, envelope, glide, accent and LFO

modules.name: SynTHBloK-P Poly
modules.description: Polyphonic unison engine for SynTHBloK

modules.name: SynTHBloK-S Stereo Phaser
modules.description: Stereo width, tilt, air, glue, punch and clip, with analyzer

modules.name: SynTHBloK-DL Character Delay
modules.description: Stereo delay with eight characters (clean, tape, analog, modern, ping-pong, dynamic, space, reverse), clock sync, hold and clear

modules.name: SynTHBloK-R Resonator
modules.description: Stereo modal resonator with metal, wood, membrane and tube bodies

modules.name: SynTHBloK MIX-6 Fire Edition
modules.description: Six-channel stereo mixer with per-channel tilt, drive, air and glue, mute/solo, meters and an aux FX bus

modules.name: SynTHBloK MIX-12 Fire Edition
modules.description: Twelve-channel stereo mixer with per-channel tilt, drive, air and glue, mute/solo, meters and an aux FX bus

modules.name: SynTHBloK MIX-8 Fire Edition
modules.description: Eight-channel stereo mixer with per-channel tilt, drive, air and glue, mute/solo, meters and an aux FX bus

modules.name: SynTHBloK Morph Filter
modules.description: Stereo drive into a state-variable filter that morphs LP to BP to HP, with audio-rate FM, 1V/oct keytrack, random chaos drift and cutoff spread

modules.name: BloKMaster
modules.description: Mastering strip: trim, tilt EQ, shelves, glue compressor, punch, limiter, stereo tools, air and output gain

modules.name: SynTHBloK Player Plus
modules.description: MIDI file player with a watch folder: 16 poly tracks (pitch, gate, velocity), 16th-note clock, reset and end outputs, speed and transpose

modules.name: SynTHBloK-K Kick
modules.description: Hard techno kick: pitch-swept sine, click, drive, tone, schranz rumble tail with ducking, accent and envelope out

modules.name: SynTHBloK MIDI + Expansion
modules.description: MIDI display for Player Plus: scrolling piano roll of the loaded MIDI with playhead, track activity and transport readout

modules.name: SynTHBloK-D Snare/Hat
modules.description: Techno snare and hi-hat voice: two-oscillator snare body with noise snap, six-oscillator metallic hats with closed/open triggers and choke, drive, tone and accent

modules.name: SynTHBloK-E Euclid
modules.description: Four-channel Euclidean rhythm generator: steps, hits and rotate per channel, clock/reset/run inputs, 10 ms trigger outputs for drums and gates

modules.name: SynTHBloK-J JAM Probe
modules.description: MIDI monitor and test transmitter for mapping controllers such as the Maschine JAM: live message log, per-control statistics, test notes/CCs, auto sweep, copy/save map summary

modules.name: SynTHBloK-K JAM
modules.description: Maschine JAM controller: 8x8 pad trigger sequencer with 8 patterns, plus the 8 touch strips as CV outputs with 8 banks; JAM lights follow the module

modules.name: SynTHBloK MTX-8
modules.description: Maschine JAM groovebox: 8x8 step sequencer driving 8 built-in synth voices (morphing oscillator, resonant filter, envelopes, drive, pan), touch strips shape each voice, stereo out

modules.name: SynTHBloK GRAIN-FORGE
modules.description: Beat shuffler, glitch, robot vocoder, clock-locked gate/filter and a warp delay whose repeats loop back through the robot and pulse stages; clock-locked stereo FX chain

modules.name: SynTHBloK MTX-DUO
modules.description: LEAD and BASS dual-oscillator mono synths (wave morph, hard sync, FM, sub, 24 dB filter, ADSR, drive, glide) with their own 8-step note sequencer in a key and scale, 8 patterns, clock/reset/run in, audio, pitch and gate out

modules.name: SynTHBloK MTX-ECHO
modules.description: Stereo delay and looper: 12 delay types (MTX ping-pong, clean digital, chorused, analog, tape, lo-fi, ducking, reverse, ping-pong, slap, octave shimmer, multi-head space echo), tap tempo and clock with 11 subdivisions incl. dual, freeze, kill dry, trails, reverb, 6 presets, 60 s stereo looper with overdub, play once and undo

modules.name: SynTHBloK MTX-LOOP
modules.description: 8-track loop sampler built on the MTX-ECHO looper: record / replace, play / stop, play once, undo / redo and clear per track, tempo-locked lengths with count-in, clock or tempo knob, mono or stereo (poly) tracks, 8 inputs with gain and monitor, 8 outputs and a stereo mix, scenes, a JAM-style grid and an OLED showing all 8 loops

modules.name: SynTHBloK MTX-FX
modules.description: 8-input effects matrix played from the MTX 8x8 grid and the Maschine JAM: 8 effect slots (64 effects in 7 tabs: drive, filter, mod, glitch, delay, reverb, dynamics), 12 one-click chains, accents, 8 routing scenes, slot links and dub chains, drag-and-drop OLED setup, musical RAND, DJ filter, 60 s tempo-locked looper (MTX-ECHO's)

modules.name: SynTHBloK MTX Composer
modules.description: Song arranger for the MTX modules: finds MTX-8, FORGE, DUO, DRUM, FX, ECHO and LOOP in the patch by itself (no cables), 8 sections A-H that set each module's pattern, mute, level and loop action, launches on the bar or beat, cycles through 1-8 sections every 1-16 bars, master clock (CLOCK, BAR, SECT) and Maschine JAM control
